$comment: Reviewed differences between the legacy scripts/preflight.mjs and rx preflight, read by scripts/compare-preflight.mjs. A legacy finding's message is split into its sub-findings (the legacy script joined several problems with '; '); each sub-finding maps to exactly one rx id through `split` (first matching `when` regex wins, else the legacy id itself) and counts as kept only when rx emits that id at the same or a higher severity with the same file:line locations.

agent-scaffolding.reason: Greptile split no-nested-review-config (high) out of no-agent-scaffolding on main b6bdcb1; rx checks it in core, so no preset exempts or caps it

screenshots.reason: presence stays under `screenshots` (the legacy rule: a view command with no screenshot is a FAIL)

changelog-order.when: PR_MERGE_DATE\} must be on the top entry|entries use \{PR_MERGE_DATE\}
changelog-order.reason: placeholder count and placement moved to `changelog-placeholder` (Q10); the predicate is shared with rx changelog
date order, date format and the Unreleased section stay under `changelog-order`

expectedNew: PASS and N/A lines for every check (docs/commands.md 1: silence is never a pass)
the JSON envelope { command, version, fingerprint, data, results, exit } instead of a bare findings array
ERROR args on an unknown argument (P1-2) and ERROR input on an unreadable --published or --preset
FAIL changelog-placeholder when no entry carries {PR_MERGE_DATE} (Q10) or the file holds conflict markers
FAIL readme-assets when README.md is missing, and FAIL icon-size, lockfile, eslint-config when those required artifacts are missing (absence rule)
FAIL screenshot-count (> 6), screenshot-format (non-.png under metadata/), icon-size (not 512×512), readme-links (unresolved relative link, Q9)

readme-assets findings for reference-style, angle-bracket, attribute-whitespace, srcset, multi-line and query-string forms (T3), and none for fenced, inline or indented code (T4); a plain link to an asset is readme-links' business, not readme-assets'
FAIL platforms when package.json declares no platforms (Greptile platforms-field on main b6bdcb1); WARN when the published copy lacks it too

preset-class checks (prettierrc, hand-typed-preferences, title-case, agent-scaffolding, dev-material, generated-files) are N/A without a preset; the comparison runs with test/fixtures/presets/legacy-compat.json, which reproduces the legacy values and levels

knownLost.message: ^README images belong in media/, not metadata/ or assets/: metadata/shot\.png, metadata/a\.png, assets/icon\.png$
knownLost.reason: T4: the legacy regex flagged a fenced Markdown example of the forbidden form; rx excludes fenced and inline code, so this exact legacy finding is a false positive the port deliberately drops (plan 4.1, job-A P1).
